q: Which of the following was decided as the capital of Andhra with the support of the majority members?
explanation:
Printed key: None (Kurnool won only with five non-Andhra votes). Strictly: the legislators' majority vote chose Kurnool (NextGen AP History Part 23 p.15).
Kurnool was chosen as capital in the 1953 vote of the legislators by majority, in line with the Sribagh Pact, though the majority depended on five non-Andhra members; Vijayawada and Guntur lost (Guntur got the High Court).

notes.text: - **Capital:** **Kurnool** – temporary capital of Andhra State from its formation on **1 October 1953** (APPSC JA 2023: "Kurnool became the capital in **1953**").

- **How it was chosen:** Rayalaseema legislators wanted the capital in their region as promised by the **Sribagh Pact**; the communists favoured **Vijayawada**; in the vote of the legislators **Kurnool won by majority**, but only with the help of **five non-Andhra members** of the residual Madras Assembly (C. Rajagopalachari had suggested they should not vote).
